title: A prime is in the image of Spec iff its fibre ring is nonzero
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $\mathfrak p\subset R$ a prime ideal with residue field $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=R_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pR_{\mathfrak p}$ and fibre ring $S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Then $\mathfrak p$ is in the image of the map $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, $\mathfrak q\mapsto\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] (that is, $\mathfrak p=\varphi^{-1}(\mathfrak q)$ for some prime ideal $\mathfrak q\subset S$) if and only if $S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)\neq0$.
